| `get_history` "},{"id":"p34s4","text":"| Daily/weekly/monthly OHLCV bars with adjusted close, plus dividends and splits in the window, as s"},{"id":"p34s5","text":"tructured data points |

Across a ten-ticker sample it was true half "},{"id":"p38s4","text":"the time, so it is worth checking rather than assuming either way."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"`currency` is what the stock trades in; `financial_currency` is what the company reports in. They di"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"ffer for ADRs, and only the latter applies to the figures in `get_financials`."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"Analyst ratings are deliberately not part of this tool even though upstream returns one. Those come from a second upstream call made"},{"id":"p41s4","text":" only when the quote says the symbol is a fund, so an equity pays nothing for them; a fund quote cos"},{"id":"p41s5","text":"ts roughly three times an equity one. If that call fails the quote is still returned, with a warning"},{"id":"p41s6","text":"s roughly three times an equity one. If that call fails the quote is still returned, with a warning."},{"id":"p42s1","text":"Three things about the fund fields are stated in a `fund_notes` block in the response itself, rather"},{"id":"p42s2","text":" than only here, because whatever reads the numbers is reading the response:"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"- `trailing_pe`, `price_to_book`, `book_value_per_share` and `eps_trailing_twelve_months` are holdin"},{"id":"p43s2","text":"gs-weighted aggregates for a fund, not one company's figures.
